correctness.rationale: The published balanced-case coefficient matrix is permutation-equivalent, up to nonzero row scalings, to independent \(2\times2\) blocks. Their determinants are exactly \(1+\eta_1^2\) and \(-(\eta_i+\eta_{k+2-i})\). Each singular block has rank one, so the stacked-matrix rank deficiency equals the displayed indicator sum and hence the hull dimension. Orbit-by-orbit counting gives the stated generating polynomial. The actual packaged verifier exhaustively confirms every twist vector in three complete prime-field test families and returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Euclidean hull dimension is the structural invariant underlying the LCD property. The new result completely resolves it for the balanced branch of a new fully twisted family, upgrades a sufficient construction theorem to an if-and-only-if criterion, and gives exact abundance of every hull dimension. This is a natural classification of the source family's main balanced regime rather than a parameter increment or a recomputation of a known table.
